scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be an adult married woman
Applicant must belong to a recognized primitive tribal group (e.g., Asur, Birhor, Hill‑Kharia, Korwa, Mal‑Paharia, etc.)
No family member should hold a government or public sector job that provides a regular salary
Family should not have a steady income from any government or public sector employment
Applicant cannot be receiving benefits from other pension schemes such as Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension or Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
If there is no married adult woman in the family, the male head of the family may receive the pension
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
